phase_impact.notes: Dash trail, left=start -> right=landing. Stretch/rotate the strip so x=22 is the origin and x=170 the destination (scale X by distance/148). Frames 0-9, play once.

purge_impact.notes: Gold dithered flood + white rim + 8 rays + sparks. Frames 0-2 are the white core flash. Scale by game radius / 88.

lockdown_impact.notes: Blue cage frame closes in (frames 0-4) while grille bars slam across, then a big padlock drops in the middle and clamps with a white shock ring (5-8), fading out (9-11). Scale by game radius / 88.

deepscan_impact.notes: Scan line sweeps top->bottom (frames 0-10) leaving scanlines + grid; target reticles lock on behind it. Scale by game radius / 88.

restore_impact.notes: Pixel plus-signs drift up with a soft green ring + dithered wash. Frames 0-11, play once.

overclock_impact.notes: Spinning gear-tooth ring with radial speed dashes; frames 0-1 core flash. Scale by game radius / 88.

railstrike_impact.notes: FLAGSHIP. 640x160, 20 frames. Charge-up: three counter-rotating ring segments converge on the muzzle while a hairline beam draws in (0-4). Fire (5-19): white-core beam with gold sheath, double helix, edge arcing, grid ticks, sonic chevrons racing down the beam, muzzle starburst and a crater + bloom + starburst + debris at the far end. For other beam lengths 3-slice: keep x<110 and x>530 fixed, stretch the middle. Rotate to aim; origin = muzzle (64,80).

pause_impact.notes: Giant bronze/gold clockwork face: rim, 60 ticks, three meshing gears, hands that spin then lock at 12. Frames 0-11, play once (fades from frame 8). Scale by game radius / 88.

wildfire_impact.notes: FLAGSHIP. 384x384, 24 frames. White-hot ignition flash (0-3), shockwave + haze rings, glowing lava cracks, 3 spiral flame arms, 3 nested rings of tongues, a central fire pillar (frames 2-14), 90 embers; fades from frame 17. Scale by game radius / 170.

deepfreeze_impact.notes: FLAGSHIP. 384x384, 24 frames. Ignition flash (0-3), frost floods out over a hex-ice floor with turning light rays, glacier crystal clusters, triple snowflake core and falling snow (4-13), then SHATTERS from frame 14 (shards of 3 sizes + frost mist). Sync the bonus-damage pop to frame 14. Scale by game radius / 170.

thunderstorm_impact.notes: FLAGSHIP. 384x384, 24 frames. Ignition flash (0-3), rain-lashed charged ground zone with crawling rim arcs and strobe flashes every 6 frames, towering storm cloud overhead (centre y=58, above the caster) throwing branching bolt trees onto the zone, 8 bolts radiating from the caster. Scale by game radius / 170.

thunderstorm_strike.notes: FLAGSHIP. 160x288, 14 frames. Per-strike hit: a thick bolt tree with 3 levels of branches crashes down (0-8) with a column flash, scorch cracks, double shock ring and sparks (3-13). Origin = (80, 250), the point of impact. Play once.

overclock_aura.notes: Orbiting amber sparks with trails + flickering ring, around the player. Loop frames 0-7 while OVERCLOCK is active (6 s). Centre = (32,32).

deepscan_aura.notes: Four bracket corners + a scan line bobbing top/bottom around the player. Loop frames 0-7 while DEEP SCAN is active (8 s). Centre = (32,32).

thunderstorm_aura.notes: FLAGSHIP. 96x96, 8-frame loop. A turning storm cloud floats over the player (cloud centre y=14) dropping bolts, with arcs crackling round the body. Loop frames 0-7 while THUNDERSTORM is active (6 s). Player centre = (48,56).

pause_aura.notes: Small bronze clock with a turning gear and a second hand + pause glyph overhead. Loop frames 0-7 while PAUSE is active (4 s). Centre = (32,32).
